leverage.exposure: The account is leveraged and must be back to non-negative before the matchday locks, or the entire matchday scores zero. The lock is a week away, so this is not yet urgent and does not by itself warrant interrupting anyone — but it is the constraint that is suppressing every buy on the board, and the two-leg unwind that clears it has to actually execute. The second leg is manual and time-boxed to the fifth. If the Treu listing has not cleared by the weekend, that is the point at which the plan needs a second look rather than a third sale.

binding_gap: Attacking cover. The squad carries exactly two attackers, which forces every legal formation to use both and leaves no replacement if either is unavailable at the lock. Secondary to that, once the unwind completes the back line is filled to the last slot by the weakest body in the squad, with no spare defender if the flagged centre-back does not clear in time. Both gaps are real and neither can be closed while the account is leveraged, which is the honest ordering: the deficit must go first.

SELL HIM ONCE mv >= 6.500.000, and in any case BEFORE 2026-10-09T18:30:00Z — a negative balance at matchday start scores ZERO for the whole matchday, and that risk outranks recovering the premium. If mv has still not reached 6.500.000 by the 08.10 run, sell anyway and take the loss: the deadline binds, the premium does not.

buy.reason: Empty, and empty on arithmetic rather than taste. Spending power reads as a large number and it is misleading: with the account leveraged, genuine free headroom is what the two unwind legs raise over the deficit, and that is a fraction of what the floor permits. Nothing on the board inside that headroom has a season average above Nakuzola's — the cheap bodies there either carry no points record at all or are worse than what is already owned. The buy that hurts is Ebnoutalib: relisted by Kickbase at exactly market value, rising flag, a genuine attacking record, and the squad is short an attacker. He still cannot be bought. Funding him would need a fourth unwind leg, and the only leg large enough is Engelhardt, which closes the money and destroys the points. Re-evaluate him after tomorrow's tick, when the Treu ask may have cleared.

Oktober) wieder einsatzbereit zu sein" — i.e. on track for MD5 itself. So the st 2 is a real but closing absence. (1) HE CANNOT BE UNWOUND, WHICH IS THE TEST THAT ACTUALLY BINDS. Manager ask from Borussia Rumpelfuss, listed 2026-09-30T15:05:56Z, prc 15.000.000 against mv 12.580.331. Buying takes cash from -10.773.918 to -25.773.918 and the squad to 13, which permits exactly TWO sales before the 11-man floor. The two largest sellable bodies are Treu 12.818.870 and Deman 10.806.960 = 23.625.830, which leaves the balance at -2.148.088. A negative balance at the MD5 start scores ZERO for the entire matchday. There is no third sale that keeps eleven players, so the position is unwindable only by breaking the floor. This is a hard kill, not a price quibble.

(2) EVEN AT mv HE IS POINTS-NEGATIVE, WHICH IS THE SURPRISE AND THE REASON TO LOG IT. Suppose the ask came down to mv 12.580.331: cash -23.354.249 against the same 23.625.830 of unwind = +271.581, so it barely clears. But the unwind now costs Deman (ap 101) as well as Treu (ap 76), and the squad lands at 11, which forces Nakuzola (ap 27) into the XI. Fielded ap goes 1353 -> 1353 - 76 - 101 + 144 + 27 = 1347. That is SIX POINTS WORSE for 12,6M of churn. The ap 144 headline is an illusion created by the two bodies it takes to pay for him.

(3) THE PRICE IS OUTSIDE EVERY MEASURED BAND ANYWAY. +19,24% over mv on a MANAGER ASK, against a measured manager-to-manager clearing band of +3,06% to +4,35%, widened only to +6,62% by the Stiller clear (H53duk0). That is roughly 3x the top of the band, and a manager ask is seller's choice, not an auction, so there is no contest to lose by refusing. Nothing above +6,62% has ever cleared manager-to-manager in this league.

REVERSAL: require ALL of: the ask AT OR BELOW mv; the squad at 13 or more so his purchase does not consume two fielded bodies; and a recomputed fielded-ap delta that is POSITIVE after counting whoever actually funds him. Being ap 144 is NOT a reversal - that was already true when he was killed.
